theorem sZMod_eq_s (p' : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod (p' + 2) i = (s i : ZMod (2 ^ (p' + 2) - 1)) := by
  induction' i with i ih
  · dsimp [s, sZMod]
    norm_num
  · push_cast [s, sZMod, ih]; rfl

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Field
theorem mul_def (a b : Nimber) :
    a * b = sInf {x | ∃ a' < a, ∃ b' < b, a' * b + a * b' + a' * b' = x}ᶜ := by
  change Nimber.mul a b = _
  rw [Nimber.mul]
  simp_rw [exists_prop]
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Holor
theorem cprankMax_nil [Monoid α] [AddMonoid α] (x : Holor α nil) : CPRankMax 1 x := by
  have h := CPRankMax.succ 0 x 0 (CPRankMax1.nil x) CPRankMax.zero
  rwa [add_zero x, zero_add] at h

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Squarefree
theorem minSqFac_has_prop (n : ℕ) : MinSqFacProp n (minSqFac n) := by
  dsimp only [minSqFac]; split_ifs with d2 d4
  · exact ⟨prime_two, (dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd d2).1 d4, fun p pp _ => pp.two_le⟩
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with n0 | n0
    · subst n0
      cases d4 (by decide)
    refine minSqFacProp_div _ prime_two d2 (mt (dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd d2).2 d4) ?_
    refine minSqFacAux_has_prop 3 (Nat.div_pos (le_of_dvd n0 d2) (by decide)) 0 rfl ?_
    refine fun p pp dp => succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne pp.two_le ?_)
    rintro rfl
    contradiction
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with n0 | n0
    · subst n0
      cases d2 (by decide)
    refine minSqFacAux_has_prop _ n0 0 rfl ?_
    refine fun p pp dp => succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne pp.two_le ?_)
    rintro rfl
    contradiction

  h.down.down

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Basic
theorem lt_add_cases {a b c : Nimber} (h : a < b + c) : a + c < b ∨ a + b < c := by
  obtain ha | hb | hc := add_trichotomy <| add_assoc a b c ▸ add_ne_zero_iff.2 h.ne
  exacts [(h.asymm ha).elim, Or.inl <| add_comm c a ▸ hb, Or.inr hc]

    exact id⟩
